parameters.title: Remove indicator values outside a range
parameters.label: Set indicator values outside a [min, max] range to missing, e.g. c-org above 10 % for a model of agricultural soils. The ranges can be set interactively from the plotted distributions. Nothing is learned from the samples, the limits are fixed.

parameter.hint: The root fp of the project
The dataframe to use as input, raw = the selected dataset, previous = the latest saved parquet file, or the name of a parquet file derived in earlier step(s), e.g. the output of detect_outliers.
Comma separated list of the indicators to show and range; empty = all indicators
JSON string with the start range per indicator, e.g. {"c-org": {"min": 0, "max": 10}}; omit min or max for an open end; indicators without an entry start open.
true = print and plot the distributions and change ranges by typing <indicator> <min> <max> until Enter accepts; false = apply data_range as given.
Save the distribution plot under plot/
Optional user extension (1-6 letters, digits or -) added to the file suffix after a hashtag, e.g. .ir#agri, to tell apart outputs with different ranges.
